identity.normalizationNote: Packet entries already merge split synonyms (ID-2); every position cited is the normalized one-based position, identical to the packet index + 1.

surfactants.class: mild anionic (assigned by chemistry: glucoside carboxylate, closest to ether carboxylates)

preservatives: 2-BROMO-2-NITROPROPANE-1,3-DIOL@19 (preservative not on the closed W-LINE b list or the E3 list)
formulaFacts.labelFact: Selenium sulfide: EU Annex III anti-dandruff-only active, max 1 % (DS1); informational only, no copy.

skipped: w_line_skipped:SELENIUM SULFIDE@9 (clause ii: COCO-GLUCOSIDE@12, a cleansing surfactant, is listed after it and before the cap)
wLine.derivation: SELENIUM SULFIDE@9 (class b): (i) holds (COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE@2), (ii) fails on COCO-GLUCOSIDE@12. SODIUM BENZOATE@14 (class b): (i) holds; (ii) between 14 and the cap 21 only Citric Acid, Sodium Chloride, Trisodium Ethylenediamine Disuccinate, Potassium Sorbate, 2-Bromo-2-Nitropropane-1,3-Diol, Linalool -> plausible. W-line 14. No alphabetical run. The formula has no payload_lipid, so the W-line gates nothing.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE@2, supported by glucosides (LAURYL GLUCOSIDE@6, COCO-GLUCOSIDE@12). Counter-signal recorded: two mild anionics (SODIUM LAURYL GLUCOSE CARBOXYLATE@4, SODIUM LAUROYL METHYL ISETHIONATE@7); in an amphoteric-led chassis they do not realistically move the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture with little substantive slip - no silicone, cationic polymer, cationic conditioner, payload lipid or pearlizer; only the weak refatter GLYCERYL OLEATE@10 and GLYCERIN@5. C2 not met.

weightPotential.rationale: low: deposition is absent apart from one weak refatter (GLYCERYL OLEATE@10); no silicone, cationic, lipid, protein or film-former family; the mild amphoteric/glucoside chassis (reset weak) faces almost nothing to remove. The acrylate crosspolymer@8 is a suspending agent (excluded, 6.4).

excluded: ACRYLATES/C10-30 ALKYL ACRYLATE CROSSPOLYMER@8 (anionic acrylate rheology polymer suspending the selenium sulfide, 6.4)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Glycerin@5 and Glyceryl Oleate@10 give light refatting; reset is weak.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Only a single weak refatter is present; nothing in the formula is designed to deposit or persist.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate needs at least one plausibly persistent depositing system; none exists (W2 does not apply: only one deposition family, weak_refatter, plus humectants).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: None material: complete formula, all ingredients recognized, no deposition system.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only, claims hidden): general. No claim direction is visible in the blind pass, so no specialist focus has a claim-plus-formula case yet (7.2 "unsupported/generic claims"). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation: nonspecific. Formula-led route that could matter: recognized dandruff active SELENIUM SULFIDE@9 (DS1) in a mild chassis.

careDirection.limitation: No conditioning system; the formula is a mild cleansing base with an anti-dandruff active.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims hidden; the provisional value can change only through 3.2 reconciliation.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula compatible: n/a until a claim names a job. Decision: provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept: no exact-product positioning is visible in the blind pass (Section 8 condition 1 cannot be met).
focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): []. Secondary focus requires distinct exact-product positioning, hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): regular, the default (Section 9). Every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction (CL-SRC), hidden in the blind pass. treatment becomes possible because dandruffSupport is supported (needs a qualifying E2 dandruff claim, U3); frequent possible with frequency wording; alternating impossible (not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would pass only through the humectant/refatting list (GLYCERIN@5, GLYCERYL OLEATE@10 prominent); there is no E4 comfort route, so an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail; an S-DRY gate could pass. Supportive: mild C6 chassis (not sufficient alone). Counter-signals: declared Parfum@21, Linalool@20.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: the complete INCI contains SELENIUM SULFIDE@9, a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11 table; DS1 for selenium sulfide). Formula-only property, final in the blind pass; whether a dandruff target is projected depends on the claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).

provisionalNotes: focusPrimary, focusSecondary, usageRole and scalpComfortTarget are claim-dependent and provisional (formula-only).
dandruffSupport supported via DS1 (selenium sulfide); a dandruff target depends on a qualifying E2 dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
